questions.question: The equation x² − 2kx + k + 3 = 0 has exactly one real solution. Find the possible values of k.
f(x)=2x−3 and g(x)=x²+1. Find all values of x for which f(g(x))=g(f(x)).
Prove that the sum of the squares of any two consecutive odd integers is always 2 more than a multiple of 4.
questions.answer: Let them be 2n+1 and 2n+3. Their squares sum to 8n²+16n+10 = 4(2n²+4n+2)+2.

questions.question: Simplify exactly: √72 − 2√18 + √8.
A rectangle has measured length 8.4 cm and width 5.7 cm, each rounded to the nearest 0.1 cm. Find the upper bound for its area.
Six workers take 14 hours to complete a task. Time is inversely proportional to the number of workers. How many workers are needed to finish in 8 hours?
questions.answer: 10.5, so 11 workers if a whole number is required.

questions.question: A cyclic quadrilateral has one interior angle of 68°. The opposite angle is x. Find x and state the theorem used.
Two similar shapes have areas 72 cm² and 200 cm². A corresponding side of the smaller shape is 9 cm. Find the corresponding side of the larger shape.
In triangle ABC, A=42°, B=67° and side a=8 cm. Find side b to 3 significant figures.
A cuboid measures 6 cm by 8 cm by 10 cm. Find the angle between its space diagonal and the 10 cm vertical edge.
P(A)=0.6, P(B)=0.5 and P(A∩B)=0.3. Determine whether A and B are independent, showing your reasoning.
A biased coin has P(H)=0.7. It is tossed twice independently. Find the probability of exactly one head.
A cumulative frequency graph represents 120 observations. Explain how you would estimate the interquartile range.
questions.answer: Read Q1 at CF 30 and Q3 at CF 90, then subtract Q1 from Q3.

questions.question: A class interval has width 8 and frequency density 3.5. Find its frequency.
The graph y=x²−6x+5 crosses the x-axis at two points. Without using the quadratic formula, find the x-coordinate of the turning point.
The iteration x(n+1)=√(7+x(n)) is used with x1=2. Calculate x2, x3 and x4 to 3 decimal places.
Solve the inequality (x−2)(x+3) < 0.
A=(2,5) and B=(8,2). Find the equation of the line through the midpoint of AB perpendicular to AB.
A rectangle has perimeter 40 cm. Express its area in terms of its length x and determine the maximum possible area.
questions.answer: A=x(20−x); maximum area 100 cm² when x=10.

questions.question: Solve (x+1)/(x−2) = 3 − 6/(x−2), stating any restriction on x.
